defer(uint256).notice: Advance the resolution block (resolver-only, on defer outcomes).

redeem(uint8).notice: Redeems the caller's FULL position (real + fake) of outcome k. Winning outcome after resolution: real → underlying at the snapshotted rate, fake → credits at the same rate. Losing outcome: no-op. Unwound: 1:1 refund.

resolve(uint8).notice: Called by the resolver at finality. A zero-supply winner unwinds the event.

wire(address[]).notice: One-time outcome-token wiring by the factory (tokens need the event address at their own init, so they deploy after the proxy address exists).
